name: mk-cc-all
description: All currently-active mk-cc-resources skills in one install: essense-flow, schema-scout, project-note-tracker, session-lifecycle, plugin-toolkit, and kb (the project knowledge base — ask before re-deriving). essense-autopilot, thorough-mode, alert-sounds, turn-end, reuse-gate, steward, patterns, and kb carry hooks and must be installed separately (the bundle ships kb's skills only — its hooks and MCP server need the standalone install; patterns' catalog travels only in its own install). verifiability-lens no longer carries a hook — its automatic firing comes from turn-end's quality-lens duty. Benched plugins are preserved on the archive/benched-plugins branch.
